It's a fullstack application with always-on agents. It has useful system tools such the ability to create databases, cron jobs and workspace applications. The interface is a canvas of ideas and threads, where team members can work, see what others are working on, chat together, hands-off work, and generate dynamic interfaces. We have been using AI to build our previous startup since chatgpt came out. From copy pasting code, to cursor, taskmaster, CC, openclaw, codex, and so on ... And it just dawned on us recently, when setting up openclaw, that: 1 - None of these tools were natively multiplayer. Human to human context is bridged through chat app (slack), bloated CRMs (hubspot), and todo lists (linear, asana,..). 2 - An LLM on it's own server doesn't need any of that, it can set up databases, write it's own tools, and generate interfaces as needed. Start speaking. 4x faster. Stop typing. Start speaking. 4x faster. Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Zachary Suh Maker Hey Product Hunt! We're Zach and Sahil, and we're building Cardamom, an AI voice line that answers all incoming phone calls for takeout heavy restaurants. Zach started running restaurants at 17 and owned his own by 19. He worked in five restaurants under Michelin chefs. One common theme across the restaurant industry is what's called "organized chaos", when a situation appears completely chaotic but actually has an underlying structure. We spoke with 32 restaurants in the Washington, DC area and found that while most were surviving on organized chaos, key details were slipping. At a busy Indian restaurant near our college, phones rang off the hook and went unanswered. Even when they picked up there phone, they're order was quickly inputted in Toast or Square and hung up, no record of who called. title: Donely Knowledge Layer
summary: Queryable company knowledge base + Closed-loop AI employees
content: Deploy, manage & scale AI employees with your company brain. - Donely | Product Hunt Donely Deploy, manage & scale AI employees with your company brain. 507 followers Deploy, manage & scale AI employees with your company brain. 507 followers Visit website Deploy OpenClaw-powered AI employees with a shared Company Brain, multi-agent collaboration, observability, AI Repair, backup inference, & isolated infrastructure built for long-running reliability. Your agents can reason across meetings, docs, tickets, chats, codebases, and internal knowledge, then safely take action with enterprise-grade controls, permissions, and workspace management. Built for startups, and enterprises running real AI employees in production. Overview Launches 3 Reviews Built with Team Awards More This is the 3rd launch from Donely . View more Donely Knowledge Layer Launching today Queryable company knowledge base + Closed-loop AI employees Visit Most AI agents are blind. They run without real company context and stop after isolated tasks. Donely Knowledge Layer gives your AI employees a queryable company brain connected to meetings, docs, chats, tickets, and codebases. This enables closed-loop workflows where agents can understand context, take action, observe outcomes, and continue work autonomously. Your AI employees can now understand what happened, what’s happening, and what needs to happen next. Payment Required Launch tags: YC Application Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 16 Day Rank Upvote • 96 points Follow Donely Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info donely.ai Donely Info Launched in 2026 View 3 launches Forum p/donely Awards View all Subscribe Sign in Social Instagram LinkedIn X Previous Donely Launches Donely Openclaw for teams to deploy business + client instances Launched on April 15th, 2026 3 84 Donely Your own OpenClaw instance for $0/mo Launched on March 16th, 2026 9 236 Reviews Most Informative View all No reviews yet Be the first to leave a review for Donely Leave a review ElevenAgents by ElevenLabs — Scale conversations without scaling your team Scale conversations without scaling your team Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Harsha Abegunasekara Donely Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt, Harsha here, founder of Donely. We started Donely because OpenClaw is powerful, but running it in production is still painful. You need setup, infra, uptime, credentials, channels, memory, and someone to fix things when it breaks. That’s fine for hackers. It’s not fine if you’re a founder, agency, or business trying to actually use AI employees every day. So we built Donely. Today, Donely lets you deploy and manage OpenClaw-powered AI employees in the cloud. Each instance is isolated, has its own access, channels, billing, and AI repair layer. But the bigger vision is what I’m most excited about: AI employees should not be blind. They should understand your company. So we’re building a queryable company brain underneath them. Meetin
